title: New stakes delegated even when validator is inactive
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  The `StakingManager` contract manages staking operations and validator delegation in the HYPE staking system. When users stake HYPE tokens through the `stake()` function, the funds are distributed via the internal `_distributeStake()` function, which handles both buffer management and delegation to validators.  Currently, `_distributeStake()` delegates funds to the validator address returned by `validatorManager.getDelegation()` without verifying if that validator is still active.
